raw.setBoundary: Sum your total money raised across all charity events you explicitly participated in within the provided sessions (include sponsor/team-raised amounts mentioned).
raw.missingRisk: If there are additional charity events/amounts in other sessions not included in the catalog, they would change the total. Also, some amounts might be team-raised vs. your personal raised share; the downstream answerer may need to interpret whether to sum full event/team totals or only amounts personally attributed to you.
